description: Historical, virtual-only comparison of medium-term staircase, ATR, hybrid, and equal-weight buy-and-hold using stored MOEX daily bars.

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (arm) arm, total_equity, drawdown_pct, open_positions FROM medium_term_replay_equity WHERE run_id = ${run} ORDER BY arm, trade_date DESC), drawdowns AS (SELECT arm, max(drawdown_pct) AS max_drawdown FROM medium_term_replay_equity WHERE run_id = ${run} GROUP BY arm), trades AS (SELECT arm, count(*) AS closed_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS realized_pnl FROM medium_term_replay_trades WHERE run_id = ${run} GROUP BY arm) SELECT latest.arm, latest.total_equity, latest.total_equity / NULLIF((run.config_json->>'initial_cash')::numeric, 0) - 1 AS total_return, drawdowns.max_drawdown, latest.open_positions, COALESCE(trades.closed_trades, 0) AS closed_trades, trades.win_rate, trades.avg_net_return, trades.realized_pnl FROM latest JOIN medium_term_replay_runs run ON run.id = ${run} JOIN drawdowns USING (arm) LEFT JOIN trades USING (arm) ORDER BY latest.arm

SELECT trade_date::timestamp AS time, total_equity::double precision AS value, arm AS metric FROM medium_term_replay_equity WHERE run_id = ${run} AND $__timeFilter(trade_date::timestamp) ORDER BY trade_date ASC, arm

SELECT trade_date::timestamp AS time, drawdown_pct::double precision AS value, arm AS metric FROM medium_term_replay_equity WHERE run_id = ${run} AND $__timeFilter(trade_date::timestamp) ORDER BY trade_date ASC, arm

SELECT exit_date, arm, ticker, signal_date, entry_date, entry_price, exit_price, initial_stop, exit_reason, held_sessions, net_return_pct, costs, net_pnl FROM medium_term_replay_trades WHERE run_id = ${run} ORDER BY exit_date DESC, id DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT arm, exit_reason, count(*) AS trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM medium_term_replay_trades WHERE run_id = ${run} GROUP BY arm, exit_reason ORDER BY arm, trades DESC

SELECT arm, ticker, count(*) AS trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_pnl > 0)::numeric / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS win_rate, avg(net_return_pct) AS avg_net_return, sum(net_pnl) AS net_pnl FROM medium_term_replay_trades WHERE run_id = ${run} GROUP BY arm, ticker ORDER BY net_pnl DESC
SELECT id, name, start_date, end_date, status, tickers_json, created_at, completed_at, error_message FROM medium_term_replay_runs WHERE id = ${run}

list.definition: SELECT id AS __value, name || ' · ' || status AS __text FROM medium_term_replay_runs ORDER BY created_at DESC
